BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back migration 022: onboarding path outcome evidence is retained permanently';
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_delete ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_identity ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox;
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate();
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_delete();
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_identity();
DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox;

COMMIT;
